conditions.candidate_selection: One candidate per arm, unchanged seeds and thresholds, no retry or selection; all ten original trial positions retained.
conditions.capacity: 12 retained FP64 coefficients / 96 bytes for every arm; second demand slot is reserved, not a production dynamic-allocation experiment.
conditions.common_initial_parent: Same immutable six-FP64 parent; copied independently into all updated slots, confirmed by source and retained parent/old-slot bytes.
conditions.independent_fits: Candidate and fixed each execute fit separately; unsplit executes an independent update loop, not a copy of candidate output.
conditions.selective_update: Same frozen six old-task coordinates; six new-task coordinates updated iff the common training/monitor gate fires.
conditions.visible_information: Same task identity, train rows, monitor labels and shared diagnostic gate. Source interfaces exclude held-out labels from learners; no separate-process visibility isolation.

cost_limitations: Four failed numerical payloads and their actual costs are unavailable.
Energy, GPU/VRAM, network and actual billing unmeasured.
Declared kernel ledger does not include every orchestration/audit overhead.
Common physical pretrain/diagnosis ran once per trial; summing per-arm comparison ledgers triple-counts that shared work.
model_class_equivalence: For the supplied task identity, both routed experts and the fixed masked tensor represent the same piecewise linear functions and use equivalent optimizer updates.
original_failure_attribution: The scalar/vector one-ULP issue is independently demonstrated; the four lost numerical payloads prevent exact individual attribution.
p4_remaining: Actual descendant-improver comparison with common starting system, hidden tasks and total budget.
p5_remaining: Same-candidate long-service quality, tail latency, effective throughput, resource, recovery, state-growth and total-cost measurements.
review_scope: Source inspection plus independent archived data, inference, diagnostic gate, and declared cost ledger checks; no optimizer or training-trajectory replay.
